import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
sums = rng.integers(1, 7, size=(500, 2)).sum(axis=1)
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.set_xlabel('Sum of two dice')
ax.set_ylabel('Rolls')
ax.hist(sums, bins=range(2, 14), align='left', rwidth=0.9)
